rigid_rotation_fit — DRIVE tactorque op

• Data kinds: matrix × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.rigid_rotation_fit(pts, u, window=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tactorque; tactorque.rigid_rotation_fit(pts, u, window=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("rigid_rotation_fit"))

Usage

Fits a rigid displacement u ≈ t + ω ẑ×r to the marker field inside a window by least squares: t = mean displacement, omega = Σ (x′u′_y − y′u′_x)/Σ r′² (′ = with the window mean subtracted), resid_rms = residual RMS, n. In no-slip torsion the inside of the circle rotates rigidly (u_θ = βr), so ω = β is the ground truth (the mean curl/2 comes out low because the fit leaks outside at the circle edge — 11 % measured). window = (cx, cy, R). Raises ValueError: fewer than 3 points.
